[SWS_DM_00162] Point in time for positive response for ClearDTC
Upstream requirements:
RS_Diag_04180
⌈
The
Diagnostic Server instance
shall send a positive response for a Clear-
DiagnosticInformation service after all memory is cleared in the server. This is re-
gardless how the
Diagnostic Server instance
memory is organized (splitted,
volatile, non-volatile).
⌋
